description: Direct state-on-state strikes between Israel or the United States and Iran, and whether the struck side answered with its own direct strike.
question_shape: Will the struck side carry out a direct military strike on the attacker within N days?
inclusion_rule: Include only overt strikes by one state's forces on the other state's territory or officials, acknowledged or widely attributed. Exclude proxy attacks and covert sabotage. Exchanges inside the 2026 war after its opening day are not yet entered.
